# Foundry

> Cloud-agnostic infrastructure toolkit by Standard Compute Org
> (standardcompute.org). Layered YAML configuration is the single source of
> truth; the `foundry` CLI renders it into Terraform/OpenTofu inputs, state
> backends, names/labels, env files, and project scaffolds. MIT licensed.

Key facts:
- Config precedence: organization < project < environment < foundry.local.yaml
  (maps deep-merge; scalars and lists replace; per-value provenance tracked).
- Documents: apiVersion foundry/v1; kinds Organization, Project, Environment;
  schemas in config/schema/ (JSON Schema 2020-12).
- Module layout: modules/<capability>/<component>/<provider> for
  aws|gcp|azure|digitalocean; one contract per capability (see the capability
  README). Provider-free helper: modules/foundation/labels.
- Stacks: stacks/<project>/<stack> or stacks/<stack>; receive the full
  rendered config as var.foundry_context; state key
  <org>/<project>/<environment>/<stack>.tfstate.
- Naming: {org}-{project}-{environment}-{component}. Labels on everything:
  managed-by/org/project/environment.
- Safety: prod applies need --allow-prod; secrets are sops+age only;
  security defaults (encryption, deny-by-default ingress, IMDSv2, private
  buckets) are contractual.
- Machine context command: `foundry context --format json`.
- Agent rules: /AGENTS.md at the repository root.

- [Home](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/index.md): overview and map
- [Quickstart](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/getting-started/quickstart.md): clone to planned VPC
- [Concepts](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/getting-started/concepts.md): the six-word vocabulary
- [Configuration model](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/configuration/model.md): documents, context, exports
- [Precedence](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/configuration/precedence.md): merge rules and provenance
- [Module contracts](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/modules/contracts.md): the provider-portability rules
- [Stacks](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/stacks.md): deployable units and CLI injection
- [CLI reference](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/cli.md): every command
- [CI/CD](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/ci-cd.md): pipelines, environment protection, drift
- [Security](https://standardcompute.github.io/foundry/security.md): posture and guardrails
